source.description:
Ricky Hsiao Promotional Portrait

Ricky Hsiao, the award-winning Taiwanese singer, poses against a plain gray backdrop wearing a burgundy jacket and dark sunglasses. He offers a thumbs-up with a warm smile, showcasing his approachable and upbeat personality.

Hsiao, known for hits like “你是我的眼” and “末班车,” will make his Singapore solo concert debut on August 19 at 8pm in the Sands Theatre at Marina Bay Sands. A four-time Golden Melody Award winner, he blends humor and heartfelt performance, promising fans both great music and his signature wit.

Ricky Hsiao's Reflective Moment

Ricky Hsiao stands in a softly lit dressing room, clad in a black suit and tinted sunglasses, gazing downward as a ring of illuminated bulbs frames his reflection. The neutral beige walls and circular light fixtures create an intimate backstage atmosphere, highlighting his composed posture and contemplative expression before a performance or photoshoot.

source.description:
Ricky Hsiao’s “说故事的歌” Album Cover

Ricky Hsiao sits pensively at a wooden desk, dressed in a beige blazer and dark sunglasses. A vintage radio and a softly glowing lamp create a nostalgic atmosphere against a rich wood-paneled background. The album title “说故事的歌” and the artist’s name appear in elegant gold typography alongside the English name “RICKY HSIAO” and the label “SABA.”

Released in 2022 on Apple Music, “说故事的歌” features 10 tracks totaling 47 minutes. The cover’s warm lighting and retro elements reflect the storytelling theme of the album.

source.description:
Ricky Hsiao’s "Being Loved" Cover

Ricky Hsiao stands confidently against a soft gray backdrop, dressed in a light green blazer over a patterned shirt and reflective aviator sunglasses. The album title "Being Loved" is prominently displayed at the top, accompanied by its Chinese translation "一直被愛著" in elegant script. His name appears vertically on the left in English and at the bottom in Chinese characters, creating a balanced and modern layout.

This cover art represents the Mandopop single released by Warner Chappell Music, Hong Kong Limited Taiwan Branch. The minimalist design and muted color palette draw attention to Hsiao’s relaxed pose
